_about: Built by scripts/build-game-pool.py from the Game and Quiz cards on tools/index.html. Do not edit.

games.name: Are You Ready for Love? Quiz
games.line: Eight questions on what you want, your standards, how healed you are, and whether pressure is driving who you date.

games.name: Are You a Girl's Girl?
games.line: Ten friendship situations, from aso ebi money to her man's flirty DM. Find your girl's girl type and send it to the group chat.

games.name: Red Flag Radar
games.line: Call each dating situation green flag, let's talk or red flag, and see what your radar says.

games.name: Is He Husband Material?
games.line: Answer from what you have seen him do and see what he is showing you, plus what to raise with him.

games.name: Couple Alignment
games.line: Both answer 12 questions on money, children, family and home, then see where you agree.

games.name: Delulu or Clear-Eyed?
games.line: Ten talking-stage situations, from the unanswered story to the "we'll see". Delulu or clear-eyed? Send your result to the group chat.

games.name: How Do You Love?
games.line: Ten everyday relationship moments. Find out if you love like the reassurer, the space-keeper, the steady one or the all-in one.

games.name: Put a Finger Down: Dating Edition
games.line: Ten dating lines, ten fingers. Put one down for each that has happened and see how many you have left.

games.name: Baby Name Battle
games.line: Pick one name from each of 12 pairs, send it to your partner and see which names you both chose.

games.name: Old Wives' Tales: True or False? Pregnancy Edition
games.line: Ten pregnancy beliefs families repeat. Tap True, False or It depends and see the source.

games.name: Pregnancy Cravings Tier List
games.line: Rank suya, agege bread, puff-puff and more in S, A, B, C or Never, then save your tier list.

games.name: What Kind of Mum Will You Be?
games.line: Nine pregnancy moments, from the baby shower to the aunty advice. Planner, soft-life, hype or Naija-strict mum?

games.name: Who Knows Mummy Best?
games.line: She answers ten questions, guests guess and get a score. For people she has already told.

games.name: 3am Group Chat
games.line: Pick your 3am thought, get a friend's reply as a chat card and send it to a new mum.

games.name: How Well Do You Know Me?
games.line: One spouse answers ten questions, the other guesses. Get a score out of ten.

games.name: Mum Wrapped
games.line: Tap through cards that count your first six weeks with a baby, then save the last one for your Status.

games.name: Omugwo: Your Mum or His Mum?
games.line: Nine omugwo dilemmas, from who comes first to who runs the kitchen. Team My Mum, His Mum, Both or Just Us?

games.name: Visitors Bingo
games.line: Tick what every visitor says or does after the birth and send it to the group chat.

games.name: Finish Mummy's Sentence
games.line: A new Nigerian mum line every day. Guess how Mummy finishes it in four tries and send your squares.

games.name: Milestone Guess
games.line: Guess the age for eight baby milestones and see the CDC and WHO ranges.

games.name: New Parent Bingo
games.line: Tick the newborn moments you have lived through and see how many lines you get.

games.name: Old Wives' Tales: True or False? Baby Edition
games.line: Ten newborn and baby beliefs. Tap True, False or It depends and see the source.

games.name: Which Nigerian Parent Are You?
games.line: "Go and ask your father." The remote control. "I will count to three." Which Nigerian parent are you?
